thread:
Sam: Morning team — quick async standup for API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits.
Sam: What I did: rolled canary for jwt-rotation on edge.
Sam: Blockers: seeing sporadic 429s from mobile thinburst on pool-b.
Sam: Today: follow up on rate-policy patch + ping PR reviews. @Maya @Lee pls. :wave:

Maya: saw the canary. 429s look correlated with token refresh loop on iOS14 — middleware retries + client early retry. pushed fix branch fix/jwt-backoff (PR #4321).

Anita: Reviewing #4321 now. quick q: is backoff safe for all clients? if not, add header `X-Allow-early-retry: true` and gate it.

Lee: tested fix locally with small load script; reduced 429s by ~70%. note: rate limiter config still has `burst=50` for `/v1/text` — suggest lower to 20 for mobile traffic. I'll open config PR. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for canary-jwt-rotator finished at 1742510100; 10% traffic -> green.

Sam: awesome. Lee, ping me the config PR. also can we add a tiny smokecheck in CI that hits middleware with missing `Authorization` to assert 429->401 mapping? simple curl test.

Lee: done. PR #4330 for rate change, PR #4331 adds smokecheck (bash). test snippet: ```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Authorization:' $GATEWAY/v1/text; done
```

Maya: left one inline on #4331 about flaky timing. also saw token_service uses `retries=3` default; maybe drop to 1 for mobile to avoid thundering-herd. :thinking_face:

Anita: will merge #4321 after CI passes. FYI I'll own rollback if we see >1% 429 in next 2h. @Sam can you watch the dashboard? :eyes:

Sam: Yep — watching latency + 429 rate on the gateway dashboard.

Sam: Quick ask: assign a reviewer for PR #4330? @Priya maybe?

Priya: I can take #4330 after standup. ETA ~1h.

Sam: Great. Nothing else from me. thanks all. :thumbsup:
